Heavenly Sewers.name: Heavenly Sewers
Heavenly Sewers.desc: The Heavenly Sewers are a secluded patch of sewers gated off from a larger pipe system. They are supposedly somewhere under the city of Statehelm, although the Statehelm Sewers are unreachable from the Heavenly Sewers. This location is considered a Mysterious Locale.

New Prestonbule Cave.name: New Prestonbule Cave
New Prestonbule Cave.desc: New Prestonbule Cave is a recently re-inhabited cave located in the frozen tundra of Gazluk. Once used as storage for the town of Prestonbule, the cave now offers weary travelers a safe place to rest and recuperate from the bitter cold outside.

Sacred Grotto.name: Sacred Grotto
Sacred Grotto.desc: The Sacred Grotto is a secret Warden base in the Kur Mountains. This oasis of safety in the harsh landscape is home to both Awakened and naturally intelligent creatures. The Grotto can only be entered in animal form, though 3-hour form is not required. The quest from Norbert...

The Yellow Room.name: The Yellow Room
The Yellow Room.desc: The Yellow Room is a fake pocket dimension that was created by Rixie in a state of desperation. This location is considered a Mysterious Locale. The area does not allow flight but enables infinite jump height by holding down the jump key.

Trapdoor.name: Trapdoor
Trapdoor.desc: The Trapdoor is a small underground space accessible by a trapdoor at the base of a stone tower in northeastern Vidaria. It is considered a Mysterious Locale.

Underwater Cave.name: Underwater Cave
Underwater Cave.desc: The Underwater Cave is a flooded cave. The entrance is at the bottom of the ocean, slightly east of the Northeast Island of Sun Vale

Anagoge.name: Anagoge
Anagoge.desc: Anagoge Island is a remote storm-blown island off the coast of the Council Lands of Alharth. Few sailors are willing to tempt the treacherous waters, preferring to stick to the coast of the nearby Serbule region. In recent years, an increased number of mind-wiped adventurers...

Phantom Ilmari Desert.name: Phantom Ilmari Desert
Phantom Ilmari Desert.portal: It seems to beckon you, as if you're expected.
Phantom Ilmari Desert.desc: Phantom Ilmari Desert is a dream of Ilmari created by a scion of Gulagra attempting to break into the Dream Realm of Miraverre.

Serbule.name: Serbule
Serbule.desc: The Duchy of Serbule was once a prosperous land, but fell into disarray after the Duke of Serbule vanished. After the disaster at Dwyndarre, Serbule Keep was rebuilt as a refugee town for the survivors. While most of the population is Elven, some Humans remain to act upon the...

Serbule Hills.name: Serbule Hills
Serbule Hills.portal: The northeast logging camp, now overrun by goblins.
Serbule Hills.desc: Serbule Hills is a region south of Serbule, but still part of what was once the Duchy of Serbule. Logging camps and large farms provided Serbule with a steady flow of raw materials to export and trade with. After the Goblin Clans in Sedgewick Forest invaded, most of the farmers...

Anagoge Records Facility.name: Anagoge Records Facility
Anagoge Records Facility.desc: The Anagoge Records Facility is a training, storage, and records facility once maintained by the once prestigious Stronmar Academy. The facility was constructed under the storm-blown Island of Anagoge, a hard to visit place far from Statehelm.

Serbule Hills Spider Cave.name: Serbule Hills Spider Cave
Serbule Hills Spider Cave.desc: The Serbule Hills Spider Cave is a cave system that can be reached by new players during their escape from the Anagoge Records Facility. It also has an exit to Serbule Hills. In Serbule Hills, the cave entrance can be found along the hillside just northeast of the region's Inn....

Brain Bug Cave.name: Brain Bug Cave
Brain Bug Cave.desc: Brain Bug Cave is a secluded cave in the northern hills of the Serbule region. Rumors suggest that Dalvos spent some time here, as his creations still roam the cave. Pickled Brain jars can sometimes be found on the ground, remnants of his mad alchemical experiments.

Crystal Cavern.name: Crystal Cavern
Crystal Cavern.desc: Crystal Cavern, also known as the "creepy crystal cave" or the "caves under Serbule", is a small cave that lies beneath the giant red crystal found north of Serbule Keep. This area can be deadly for low level adventurers due to the poison stacking caused by the creatures found...

Ranalon Den.name: Ranalon Den
Ranalon Den.desc: The Ranalon Den is a cave system in Serbule Hills currently inhabited by an invading Ranalon population. It is unknown if the underground caves existed before the Ranalon appeared in the region, but the presence of Stone-Shapers in their population and the well-organized paths...

Miscellaneous: Bottle of Brine (Found as Brine Jar)

Serbule Crypt.name: Serbule Crypt
Serbule Crypt.desc: The Serbule Crypt is a tomb inhabited by low-level naturally-occurring Undead, although the further from the entrance an adventurer explores the stronger they become. The turbulent history of the Serbule region has left its mark on the crypt, with at least one powerful...

Eltibule.name: Eltibule
Eltibule.desc: Eltibule is a hilly region of the Council Lands which borders both Serbule and Sedgewick regions. The lands were once home to the Duchy of Eltibule, though in recent years the land is patronless as each member of the Eltibule family met an ill fate. Eltibule Keep, their former...

Eltibule Crypt.name: Eltibule Crypt
Eltibule Crypt.desc: Eltibule Crypt is located in the graveyard near Eltibule Keep. It is the traditional burial grounds for the Eltibule family. A sign near the graveyard fence informs visitors that an original Eltibule was a Duke from the Pre-Council era. It also warns that the family plot is a...

Goblin Dungeon.name: Goblin Dungeon
Goblin Dungeon.desc: Goblin Dungeon is a regional name for the disastrous construction project underneath Eltibule Keep. This ill-fated maze of storehouses was overrun by Goblins, and the promised cleanup team sent from Statehelm never arrived. The residents of the Keep have boarded up the entrance...

Wood: Oak Wood Chips (Broken Barrels or crates)
Scroll: Tanning: Every Way To Make Leather Strips

Carpal Tunnels.name: Carpal Tunnels
Carpal Tunnels.desc: Carpal Tunnels, once known as "Under the Hand," is a dungeon in Serbule that earns its name due to the large stone rock hand the dungeon can be found under. The stone hand is actually part of a mostly buried stone statue, of which the head and the other hand can be seen...

Myconian Cave.name: Myconian Cave
Myconian Cave.desc: The Myconian Cave is located underneath one of the many giant mushrooms spread about Northwest Serbule. Named for its fungoid inhabitants, the cave provides adventurers a good source for both harvestable and lootable mushrooms. Although the primary surface entrance to the cave...

Animal Nexus.name: Animal Nexus
Animal Nexus.desc: The Animal Nexus, sometimes called the Nexus Annex, is a cavern formed in a Fae Nexus realm which became connected to Eltibule. These ever-shifting, twisted caverns can connect any number of realms, but this one is unusually stable. Fae creatures, presumably dispatched by the...

Boarded up Basement.name: Boarded up Basement
Boarded up Basement.desc: Boarded up Basement is found underneath a "model home" in the Eltibule region. According to Jesina, the model house was built by the Council as part of a plan to attract new settlers. A signpost nearby reads: "Accept the Council's generous homesteading agreement and receive a...

Hogan's Basement.name: Hogan's Basement
Hogan's Basement.desc: Hogan's Basement is the name given to the tunnels and storerooms under Hogan's Keep, a once abandoned guardhouse The Council granted ownership of to the staff-wielder Hogan. of Hogan can be granted permission to enter Hogan's Basement, where a band of Goblins has been granted...

Scroll: Tailoring: Add Psychic Damage to Cloth Shirt

Kur Mountains.name: Kur Mountains
Kur Mountains.portal: A windy path leads to the freezing Kur Mountains, and then on to Gazluk.
Kur Mountains.desc: The Kur Mountains are part of a mountainous region found north of Eltibule. Always cold and snow-covered, these rolling hills and rocky peaks form the gateway to the higher elevations of the Gazluk plateau. Although formally a Council controlled land, Orcs have repeatedly...

Molybdenum Mine.name: Molybdenum Mine
Molybdenum Mine.desc: Molybdenum Mine is an underwater cavern in the Sun Vale region. Ratkin Slaves work tirelessly to mine ores from the cave, cut off from the surface by shark-infested underwater passageways. An entrance to the Molybdenum Mine can be found among some underwater rocks in the far...

Red Wing Casino.name: Red Wing Casino
Red Wing Casino.desc: Red Wing Casino is a Casino run by a group of intelligent mantises. Many skill trainers, merchants, and casino games can be found here.

Sun Vale.name: Sun Vale
Sun Vale.portal: Also mistakenly known as "The Fae Lands"
Sun Vale.desc: Sun Vale is the name given to an island chain nestled between The Council Lands and the elven country of Verta. Unusual flora and fauna has found a new home here, migrating from the Fae Realm over hundreds of years. Winter Court Fairies are common here, wreaking havoc and...

Fish Bowl Cavern.name: Fish Bowl Cavern
Fish Bowl Cavern.desc: Fish Bowl Cavern is a small underwater cave found on the southwest coast of the Ranalon infested island of Sun Vale. The layout of flora and fauna in the cavern suggests Ranalon are well-organized and capable of farming both.

Yeti Cave.name: Yeti Cave
Yeti Cave.desc: The Yeti Cave is a large cavern home to the Himamanav species and a variety of other deadly species. There are three progressively deadlier main levels to the cave, two of which are below ground level, and the cave itself branches off at various points, causing many...

Borghild.name: Borghild
Borghild.desc: Borghild, once known as the Deathrap Dungeon is accessed through the giant gate in the northeast part of Serbule. Look for a crack on the left side of the door to get in.

Dark Chapel.name: Dark Chapel
Dark Chapel.desc: A series of tunnels run beneath Eltibule, populated by necromancers and members of a mysterious cult. They lead to The Dark Chapel, named by its cultist dwellers as a sanctuary dedicated to their deity, Gulagra. Any explorers who decide to delve into this dark, unholy place...

Chests: Decoction of Ancillary Armor Augmentation Knowledge

Necromancer's Courtyard.name: Necromancer's Courtyard
Necromancer's Courtyard.desc: Necromancer's Courtyard is the second half of Kur Tower, and is a seemingly magical realm of darkness buried deep under the Kur Mountains. Home to the imprisoned Elven Necromancer Lomas, this unusual graveyard is home to many unexplainable things.

Sacrificial Sea Cave.name: Sacrificial Sea Cave
Sacrificial Sea Cave.desc: Sacrificial Sea Cave is an underwater cavern in the Sun Vale region (the cave on the East side of the Southeast island). Ranalon guard the outside, while powerful creatures are raised inside to be used in a sacrificial ritual to contact the deity Enoyos.

Winter Nexus.name: Winter Nexus
Winter Nexus.desc: The Winter Nexus is an entrance to a plane of existence made entirely of cave-like Nexuses. The shape of this realm changes over time, but the section accessed through Sun Vale is stable, forming a cavernous corridor between Alharth and the Fae Realm. This particular Nexus is...

Wolf Cave.name: Wolf Cave
Wolf Cave.desc: Wolf Cave is located on the northern shore of Kur Mountains.

Ilmari.name: Ilmari
Ilmari.portal: It's a long trek to the desert.
Ilmari.desc: Ilmari is a harsh desert region in the Council's Empire. There is little reason to travel here, and those who end up in this wasteland soon regret it.

Chemical Bottles: Potion of Extremely Minor Healing Receptiveness

Kur Tower.name: Kur Tower
Kur Tower.desc: Kur Tower (also refered as the Necromancer Lair in patch notes) is a high level dungeon found in the freezing Kur Mountains. Fire damage is quite effective, while Cold, Poison and Trauma damage are usually ineffective. Loot wise, unlike lower level dungeons where good items...

War Cache.name: War Cache
War Cache.desc: War Caches are small dungeons found in the Ilmari Desert that can be reached by taking quests given by Sir Johnson.

Rahu.name: Rahu
Rahu.desc: Rahu is bustling with craftsmen, merchants, and ships. It is known to have a great port.

Labyrinth.name: Labyrinth
Labyrinth.desc: A winding set of pathways and stairs filled with many dangerous and strange creatures. The first floor is filled with Rakshasa, while the second has more, well, unusual enemies. At the end, adventurers will find the Labyrinth...a fearsome beast dwells within.

Amaluk Valley Cave.name: Amaluk Valley Cave
Amaluk Valley Cave.desc: The Amaluk Valley Cave, also known as the Tower View Cave, is a cave system in central Gazluk.

No-Name Cave.name: No-Name Cave
No-Name Cave.desc: The No-Name Cave is a large cave system in southwest Gazluk.

Rahu Sewer.name: Rahu Sewer
Rahu Sewer.desc: The is a solo-friendly dungeon for level 60 equipment. Different zones feature different enemies and resources to harvest.

Snowblood Shadow Cave.name: Snowblood Shadow Cave
Snowblood Shadow Cave.desc: The Snowblood Shadow Cave, also known as the Gazluk Shadow Cave, is a cave system in western Gazluk.

Windy View Cave.name: Windy View Cave
Windy View Cave.desc: The Windy View Cave, also known as Foothills Cave, is is a hostile cave found just West of the Animal Outpost in Gazluk. It is home to various types of Undead.

Fae Realm.name: Fae Realm
Fae Realm.portal: Distant Terminal - You can faintly hear bees buzzing.
Fae Realm.desc: The Fae Realm is actually one of many Fae Realms ruled over by whichever Fairy Court holds the throne. With the recent changeover to the Winter Court, the Winter Queen has been making advances to subjugate all other Fae. In this Fae Realm, accessible through the Winter Nexus...

Gazluk.name: Gazluk
Gazluk.portal: Hike the mountains to the frozen Gazluk Plateau.
Gazluk.desc: Gazluk is a frozen tundra region beyond the Kur Mountains. The area is mostly known for the once public Gazluk City and the tragic incident of Prestonbule. New Prestonbule Cave is the only friendly zone. Outside of this there are several other towns, but these towns are...

Gazluk Keep.name: Gazluk Keep
Gazluk Keep.desc: Gazluk Keep is a level 70 dungeon located deep in the Gazluk zone, within the Orcish city of Gazluk.

Povus.name: Povus
Povus.portal: Hike through mountains to the warm land of Povus
Povus.desc: Povus is a Rakshasa-controlled land that serves as a buffer between the Council's jurisdiction, and the Crone Hegemony. West of Rahu and north of Gazluk, the swampy terrain of Povus is home to a variety of reptilian monsters.

The Wintertide.name: The Wintertide
The Wintertide.desc: The Wintertide is a Winter Court Navy nethership tasked with the observation of the Fae Realm adjacent to Realm U39X. Under the command of Captain Evergloam, The Wintertide holds both a breeding area for Arcta Hippogriff and a laboratory used by a genius mortal scientist.

Errruka's Cave.name: Errruka's Cave
Errruka's Cave.desc: Errruka's Cave is the entrance to a sprawling cave system underneath the Povus region. The cave system is often considered split into four sections. The Errruka's Cave, Forthragarian Caves, Nightmare Caves, and Aktaari Cave. Trainers for the majority of the level 90 unlocks can...

Fungal Fortress.name: Fungal Fortress
Fungal Fortress.desc: Fungal Fortress is a series of Myconian, Dwarven, Mantis, and Goblin tunnels converging underneath the Povus region. Just as the surface of Povus suffered from plans gone-awry, this subterranean landscape has been blighted by misfortune of its own. Accessing the dungeon...

Aktaari Cave.name: Aktaari Cave
Aktaari Cave.desc: Aktaari Cave is part of a vast cave system underneath the Povus region. This cave system is often considered split into four major sections. The Errruka's Cave, Forthragarian Caves, Nightmare Caves, and Aktaari Cave. Trainers for the majority of the level 90 unlocks can be...

Forthragarian Caves.name: Forthragarian Caves
Forthragarian Caves.desc: Forthragarian Caves is a cavern which is part of a sprawling cave system underneath the Povus region. This cave system is often considered split into four sections. The Errruka's Cave, Forthragarian Caves, Nightmare Caves, and Aktaari Cave. Trainers for the majority of the...

Nightmare Caves.name: Nightmare Caves
Nightmare Caves.desc: Nightmare Caves is part of a massive cave system underneath the Povus region. It is connected to Forthragarian Caves and Elven Judgement. Trainers for the majority of the level 90 unlocks can be found in these caves. You can teleport to these trainers if you have Teleportation...

Statehelm Crypt.name: Statehelm Crypt
Statehelm Crypt.desc: The Statehelm Crypt is a network of interconnected catacombs underneath the graveyard for the City of Statehelm. Sections of the dungeon have been locked up by mages and converted into research laboratories.

Scroll: Jewelry Crafting: Astounding Porcine Blast Disperser

Statehelm Sewers.name: Statehelm Sewers
Statehelm Sewers.desc: The Statehelm Sewers are a vast maze of pipes and drains which span the entire city of Statehelm. The sewers are accessible through multiple access points both inside and outside the city. These access points are usually locked and require permission from Ser Hackley to use....

Vidaria.name: Vidaria
Vidaria.desc: Vidaria is a former breadbasket of The Council Lands, and is a region adjacent to the current capital of Statehelm.

Elven Judgement.name: Elven Judgement
Elven Judgement.desc: Elven Judgement is a dungeon that can be reached by traversing deep into Nightmare Caves.

Statehelm.name: Statehelm
Statehelm.desc: Statehelm is the capital city of the Council Lands, and the current seat of the Council itself. Accessible by both a mid-sized port and an extensive road network, this heavily defended city is facing numerous external and internal issues.

Staging Area.name: Staging Area
Staging Area.portal: An arid wasteland smelling like Lemons.
Staging Area.desc: The Staging Area is a realm only accessible by Admins. This unusual realm is an arid basin where the ground has began to crack. A small lake occupies the lowest point of the zone, at the center of the basin. Small mountains can be seen in the distance.
